events.content:
Dashboard project links now use `prefetch={false}`, so Next won’t fetch the project page before navigation. The project heading renders as soon as the title lookup resolves; the slower details load separately and stream in under it.

Changed [app/page.tsx](/workspace/app/page.tsx) and [app/projects/[slug]/page.tsx](/workspace/app/projects/%5Bslug%5D/page.tsx). I didn’t run tests or a build.
